_comment: Guided tour of the Project data window. Steps point at the controls the view registers (form.rects by action or table key) and wait for the user to press them; the tour never presses a button itself.

steps.title: Linked, not copied
steps.text: A project links large data files -- photon streams, images -- instead of copying them: it records where each file is, its size and its checksum. The project stays small and never duplicates a measurement. This window shows those links, finds files that moved, and stores them all inside the project when it has to travel alone.

steps.title: Start with a project that has a problem
steps.text: The example is a small project with three linked files; one of them, c, was moved to a backup folder after the project was saved, and a different file of the same name was left in another folder.

steps.title: Which files are found
steps.text: One row per linked dataset: found, missing, size changed or content changed, and where the file is or was. Opening a project compares sizes only; Check checksums reads every file and compares its SHA-256 too. The missing c is selected.

steps.title: Search where it might be
steps.text: Choose a folder: every file below it with the same name is listed, the ones with the recorded size first. Nothing is read yet. In the example, choose the backup folder beside the project's folder.

await.hint: Press Search in folder… and choose the backup folder.

steps.title: The candidates
steps.text: Two files are named c.tif; the one with the recorded size comes first. Only the checksum can tell whether it is the original.

steps.title: Use it
steps.text: Use candidate compares the file's checksum with the recorded one and links the dataset to it. A different file is refused; Use anyway would accept it and record its new checksum -- for a file you know is right although it changed.

steps.title: Self-contained
steps.text: Make self-contained stores every linked file inside the project at its next save: the project then needs no other file, ready to share or deposit (a Zenodo deposit insists on it). Missing files must be located first.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: The open session is saved with File > Save Project; a project opened here -- the example -- with Save project. The file grows by the size of what was embedded.
